selected_primary_idea.title: Scale-Resolved Simulation Credibility Ledger for Error-Bounded Classical--Quantum Comparison
selected_primary_idea.summary: A quantity-of-interest and evidence ledger that classifies scale-specific classical and quantum simulation paths without assuming universal accuracy or advantage.
selected_primary_idea.research_object: Scientific simulations spanning macro continuum, atomistic, many-body quantum, and quantum-computing pathways
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: A common error/resource ledger makes simulation credibility comparable and exposes when a classical baseline, quantum candidate, or further validation is justified.
selected_primary_idea.intervention: Populate synthetic and source-bounded model cards; test error-budget closure and sensitivity before issuing a conditional status.

competitive_ideas.reason: Useful but insufficient to establish model accuracy.
